title: Swigg Tickets
tagline: A virtual events and community platform with microaccess and gated community access and discounts. Using decentralized storage to permanently store the best educational material.
description:
Filecoin storage for the best edutainment material as decided by the community.
Decentralized authentication and smart contract based charges on scroll
Micro and Mini Payments with Community voted tokens (Select crypto payments)
Community promos and discounts (NFT based gated access)
Web3 events and community platoform of choice with video and audio streaming
how_its_made:
Deployed on scroll
Filecoin decentralized storage
Smart contract whitelist for discounts and gated community access
We combine 3 essentials of the web3 world with  a concept that hopes to reshape online events and community experience via a web3 first edutainment platform with audio and video streaming capabilities
